text:
maria: Heads-up: account "Companion Health" (acct CH-882) showing ~42% drop in token usage over the last 2 weeks. Renewal in 18 days, marking as at-risk.

alex: Thanks — quick numbers? ARR / contract tier?

maria: $42k ARR, Enterprise tier. They migrated from Dedicated -> Hosted last month. Renewal owners: lauren@companion.com + procurement.

sam: Any active P0s or open escalations on their record?

maria: No P0s. Two missed enablement sessions, NPS 6 last month, and a support ticket about slow embeddings (T1234).

lauren: Looping in CSE to coordinate. @cse_bot can you attach the latest account health dashboard and notes?

cse_bot: Dashboard added: https://redwood.app/dashboards/account/CH-882 | includes usage sparkline, error rate, last 30d top endpoints

alex: Proposed quick save play: immediate outreach -> 30m technical health call -> run usage/prompt audit -> offer 1-month credits + optimized batching config. Avoid discount unless engagement stays low.

maria: Draft checklist below — please call out owners.

```
- outreach within 24h (owner: alex)
- schedule 30m health call w/ technical owners (owner: lauren)
- audit top-3 endpoints for token churn & prompt inefficiencies (owner: maria)
- propose caching / quantization + batching config (owner: sam)
- escalate to success lead if no reply in 72h
- attach save-plan artifact to account timeline
```

sam: I'll run an infra trace for model latency and KV cache hit rates. Quick query I ran locally: 
```
SELECT p90_latency, kv_cache_hit FROM infra.metrics WHERE account_id='CH-882' AND ts > now()-7d;
```

lauren: I'll message the main contact today and propose Tue 10am PT for the 30m call. If they accept, we can include a short demo of caching benefits.

alex: I'll do the outreach now and ping the thread with the meeting link. If they don't respond in 48h, we escalate to renewal manager.

maria: Assigning actions: alex (outreach), sam (latency trace + config proposal), lauren (schedule + client comms). I'll assemble the save-plan doc and link it here when ready.

alex: Ack :thumbsup:

sam: Will post trace results by EOD today.

cse_bot: Note: save-plan checklist created and attached to account timeline (CH-882).
